metadata.description: Complete image generation prompts for KWD Platform questions
metadata.usage: Use these prompts to generate realistic Cambodian driving education images

road_traffic.title_km: ច្បាប់ចរាចរណ៍ផ្លូវគោក

sample_questions.question_en: Can drivers overtake each other on the bridge?
sample_questions.question_km: តើអ្នកបើកបរអាចជែងគ្នាលើស្ពានបានដែរឬទេ ?

image_prompt.prompt: Cambodian concrete bridge over river, two-lane road with solid yellow center line, clear no overtaking zone markings painted on asphalt, red prohibition sign visible, tropical vegetation on both sides, daytime clear sky, photorealistic traffic scene, wide angle view showing full bridge length
image_prompt.negative_prompt: cartoon, anime, sketch, blurry, low quality, distorted, watermark, text overlay

sample_questions.question_en: Roads with mud or water, how shall drivers pay attention toward pedestrians?
sample_questions.question_km: ផ្លូវមានភក់ ឬទឹកដក់ តើអ្នកបើកបរត្រូវប្រុងប្រយ័ត្នដូចម្ដេច ចំពោះអ្នកថ្មើរជើង ?
sample_questions.correct_answer_en: Slow down not to splash mud or water onto the pedestrians
sample_questions.correct_answer_km: បន្ថយល្បឿនប្រយ័ត្នកុំឲ្យខ្ទាតភក់លើអ្នកថ្មើជើង

image_prompt.prompt: Urban Cambodian street after rain, wet asphalt road with puddles and mud patches, pedestrians walking on sidewalk carrying umbrellas, car approaching slowly with visible water splash potential, Phnom Penh city buildings background, overcast sky, realistic lighting, street-level perspective
image_prompt.negative_prompt: cartoon, anime, sketch, blurry, low quality, distorted, watermark, dry road, sunny weather

sample_questions.question_en: Must you wear a helmet when riding a motorcycle?
sample_questions.question_km: តើត្រូវពាក់មួកសុវត្ថិភាពពេលបើកម៉ូតូដែរឬទេ?

image_prompt.prompt: Cambodian motorcyclist wearing proper safety helmet riding on city street, clear view of approved helmet with chin strap fastened, Phnom Penh urban traffic background, mandatory helmet law enforcement sign visible, daytime safe riding demonstration, realistic safety compliance photography
image_prompt.negative_prompt: cartoon, anime, no helmet, unsafe riding, blurry, low quality, night scene

driving.title_km: ជំនាញបើកបរ

sample_questions.question_en: What is an accident to be known in driving?
sample_questions.question_km: តើអ្វីជាគ្រោះថ្នាក់ ដែលអ្នកត្រូវស្គាល់ក្នុងការបើកបរ ?
sample_questions.correct_answer_km: ផ្លូវ និង អ្នកប្រើប្រាស់ផ្លូវ

image_prompt.prompt: Busy Cambodian intersection showing various road users - motorcycles, cars, pedestrians crossing, tuk-tuks, cyclists, diverse traffic participants, urban Phnom Penh setting, multiple potential hazards visible, realistic daytime traffic scene, street-level wide angle view emphasizing road user interaction
image_prompt.negative_prompt: cartoon, anime, empty road, single vehicle, blurry, low quality, accident scene

sample_questions.question_en: Knowing a wheel is flat, what shall you do?
sample_questions.question_km: នៅពេលដឹងថាកង់បែក ឬ ធ្លាយ តើអ្នកត្រូវធ្វើដូចម្ដេច ?
sample_questions.correct_answer_en: Slow down, firmly hold the steering wheel or/and steer follow the lane.
sample_questions.correct_answer_km: ត្រូវបន្ថយល្បឿន ទប់ចង្កូតឲ្យជាប់ ឬនឹង និងកាច់ចង្កូតឲ្យត្រង់តាមគន្លងផ្លូវ

image_prompt.prompt: Driver's hands firmly gripping steering wheel inside car, dashboard showing warning light, view through windshield of car moving to shoulder lane with flat tire visible in side mirror, Cambodian highway with emergency lane markings, controlled deceleration scenario, realistic car interior and exterior view, daytime clear visibility
image_prompt.negative_prompt: cartoon, anime, panic scene, blurry, low quality, nighttime, reckless driving

sample_questions.question_en: What is the reason making the vehicles swerve off?
sample_questions.question_km: មូលហេតុអ្វីខ្លះដែលធ្វើឲ្យរថយន្តរអិលរេ ?
sample_questions.correct_answer_en: Pun on the brake firmly, steer strongly, more speed up, or drive very fast.
sample_questions.correct_answer_km: ជាន់ហ្វ្រាំងខ្លាំង កាច់ចង្កូតខ្លាំង បង្កើនល្បឿនខ្លាំង ឬបើកបរលឿនពេក

image_prompt.prompt: Car skidding on wet Cambodian road showing tire marks, driver visible through windshield making sharp steering input, speedometer showing high speed, brake lights illuminated, rainy weather conditions, loss of vehicle control scenario, realistic motion blur on wheels, educational driving safety demonstration
image_prompt.negative_prompt: cartoon, anime, dry conditions, normal driving, blurry, low quality, static vehicle

emergency.title_km: សង្គ្រោះបន្ទាន់

sample_questions.question_en: When a victim having wound with blooding, how can you help stop blooding?
sample_questions.question_km: នៅពេលជនរងគ្រោះមានរបួសហូរឈាមខ្លាំង តើអាចជួយឃាត់ឈាមដូចម្ដេច ?
sample_questions.correct_answer_en: Use good cloth or bandage to tight around the wound, fasten a bit tightly.
sample_questions.correct_answer_km: ត្រូវយកក្រណាត់ ឬបង់សសស្អាតរុំជុំវិញមុខរបួសរិតឲ្យតឹងបន្ដិច

image_prompt.prompt: First aid scene at Cambodian roadside accident, rescuer applying clean white bandage to victim's bleeding arm wound, proper pressure bandaging technique shown, first aid kit open nearby, concerned bystanders at safe distance, emergency vehicle with lights in background, daytime realistic medical assistance demonstration, educational first aid photography
image_prompt.negative_prompt: cartoon, anime, graphic injury, blurry, low quality, nighttime, unprofessional aid

sample_questions.question_en: When there is someone has an accident, what are main points needed to check to help him or her?
sample_questions.question_km: នៅពេលមានជនរងគ្រោះថ្នាក់ចរាចរណ៍តើមានចំនុចសំខាន់ៗអ្វីខ្លះ ដែលអ្នកធ្វើការត្រួតពិនិត្យ ដើម្បីជួយជនរងគ្រោះ ?
sample_questions.correct_answer_en: Unconsciousness, no breathing, no pulse, blooding, and bone break.
sample_questions.correct_answer_km: ការសន្លប់ បាត់ដង្ហើម គ្មានជីពចរ ហូរឈាម និងបាក់ឆ្អឹង

image_prompt.prompt: Emergency responder checking vital signs of accident victim lying on Cambodian roadside, medical assessment in progress showing checking consciousness level, breathing check, pulse check at neck, visual injury assessment, professional emergency response posture, ambulance and traffic safety cones visible background, daytime realistic emergency medical scene
image_prompt.negative_prompt: cartoon, anime, graphic injuries, blurry, low quality, amateur response, night scene

sample_questions.question_en: How do you realize that the victim's pulse does not work?
sample_questions.question_km: តើអ្នកដឹងថាជីពចរជនរងគ្រោះមិនដើរដោយសារអ្វី ?
sample_questions.correct_answer_en: By using fingers to press at the a side of the neck.
sample_questions.correct_answer_km: ដោយប្រើអារម្មណ៍ម្រាមដៃចុចត្រង់ចំហៀងក

image_prompt.prompt: Close-up view of first aid provider checking carotid pulse on side of victim's neck using two fingers, correct hand position demonstrated, victim lying supine on ground, focused medical technique shot, educational first aid training style, clear lighting on neck area, professional emergency care demonstration in Cambodia
image_prompt.negative_prompt: cartoon, anime, incorrect technique, blurry, low quality, nighttime, amateur

general.title_km: ចំណេះដឹងទូទៅ

sample_questions.question_km: តើអ្នកណាខ្លះដែលអាចឆ្លងមេរោគអេដស៍ ?
sample_questions.correct_answer_km: មនុស្សគ្រប់រូប

image_prompt.prompt: Diverse group of Cambodian people of different ages, professions, and backgrounds standing together - office worker, police officer, student, elderly person, healthcare worker - health awareness poster background showing HIV prevention message, inclusive community health education scene, realistic photography in Cambodia public health center
image_prompt.negative_prompt: cartoon, anime, discrimination, stigma, blurry, low quality, single demographic

sample_questions.question_km: តើមេរោគអេដស៍ ឆ្លងតាមរបៀបណា ?
sample_questions.correct_answer_en: Through sex, shared needles, contaminated blood transfusions, and from mother to child
sample_questions.correct_answer_km: តាមការរួមភេទ, ប្រើម្ជុលរួមគ្នា, ការបញ្ចូលឈាមដែលមានមេរោគ, ពីម្ដាយទៅកូន

image_prompt.prompt: Educational infographic style illustration showing HIV transmission routes: safe blood donation with proper medical equipment, mother-to-child prevention care, proper needle disposal container, condom for protection - medical education poster on wall of Cambodian health clinic, professional public health educational material, realistic photographic style
image_prompt.negative_prompt: cartoon, anime, graphic content, stigmatizing, blurry, low quality, misinformation

sample_questions.question_en: Up to now, is there a medicine that can cure the HIV/AIDS?
sample_questions.question_km: រហូតមកដល់បច្ចុប្បន្ននេះ តើមានថ្នាំសំរាប់ព្យាបាលមេរោគអេដស៍/ជម្ងឺអេដស៍ អោយជាសះស្បើយដែរ ឬទេ ?

image_prompt.prompt: Cambodian healthcare setting showing antiretroviral therapy (ART) medication bottles on pharmacy counter, medical professional explaining treatment to patient, HIV treatment awareness poster on wall, realistic modern clinic interior, professional healthcare communication scene, educational health information context
image_prompt.negative_prompt: cartoon, anime, false cure claims, blurry, low quality, traditional medicine only

loading.title_km: ការផ្ទុកមនុស្ស និងទំនិញ

sample_questions.question_en: What is the maximum number of passengers allowed in a standard sedan car?
sample_questions.question_km: តើរថយន្តស្ដង់ដារអាចដឹកអ្នកដំណើរអតិបរិមាប៉ុន្មាននាក់?
sample_questions.correct_answer_en: According to manufacturer specifications and seat belts available
sample_questions.correct_answer_km: តាមការបញ្ជាក់របស់ក្រុមហ៊ុនផលិត និងខ្សែក្រវ៉ាត់សុវត្ថិភាពដែលមាន

image_prompt.prompt: Interior view of Cambodian family sedan showing five seats with seat belts properly visible, passengers seated safely with belts fastened, vehicle capacity label on door frame visible, proper passenger loading demonstration, realistic car interior photography, daytime scene showing compliance with passenger limits
image_prompt.negative_prompt: cartoon, anime, overcrowded vehicle, no seat belts, blurry, low quality, unsafe loading

sample_questions.question_en: How should cargo be secured on a pickup truck?
sample_questions.question_km: តើត្រូវចងទំនិញនៅលើរថយន្តភីកអាប់យ៉ាងដូចម្ដេច?
sample_questions.correct_answer_en: Using strong ropes or straps, properly tied and covered with tarp if needed
sample_questions.correct_answer_km: ប្រើខ្សែ ឬខ្សែរឹងមាំ ចងឲ្យរឹងមាំ និងគ្របដោយក្រណាត់ប្រើសិនចាំបាច់

image_prompt.prompt: Cambodian pickup truck loaded with cargo properly secured using heavy-duty ratchet straps and ropes, blue tarp covering goods, load within truck bed rails, proper tie-down points visible, safe cargo loading best practices demonstration, roadside scene in Cambodia, realistic commercial vehicle loading photography
image_prompt.negative_prompt: cartoon, anime, unsecured load, overloaded, blurry, low quality, dangerous loading

sample_questions.question_en: Is it safe to transport passengers in the cargo bed of a truck?
sample_questions.question_km: តើវាមានសុវត្ថិភាពក្នុងការដឹកអ្នកដំណើរនៅក្នុងផ្នែកដឹកទំនិញរថយន្តដែរឬទេ?
sample_questions.correct_answer_en: No, it is dangerous and illegal
sample_questions.correct_answer_km: ទេ វាគ្រោះថ្នាក់ និងខុសច្បាប់

image_prompt.prompt: Safety education poster showing truck cargo bed with red prohibition symbol, separate safe passenger compartment highlighted in green, Cambodian road safety campaign material, clear visual distinction between cargo area and passenger seating, educational traffic safety illustration in realistic photographic style
image_prompt.negative_prompt: cartoon, anime, people in truck bed, unsafe practices, blurry, low quality, promoting violation

technical.title_km: បច្ចេកទេសយានយន្ត

sample_questions.question_en: What is the purpose of the vehicle's brake system?
sample_questions.question_km: តើប្រព័ន្ធហ្វ្រាំងរថយន្តមានគោលបំណងអ្វី?
sample_questions.correct_answer_en: To slow down or stop the vehicle safely
sample_questions.correct_answer_km: ដើម្បីបន្ថយល្បឿន ឬបញ្ឈប់រថយន្តឲ្យមានសុវត្ថិភាព

image_prompt.prompt: Close-up cutaway view of modern disc brake system on car wheel, brake caliper gripping rotor disc, brake pads visible, hydraulic brake line connection shown, technical automotive photography showing brake components, Cambodian auto workshop background, educational mechanical illustration style, realistic detailed machinery
image_prompt.negative_prompt: cartoon, anime, rusty parts, broken system, blurry, low quality, incomplete view

sample_questions.question_en: How often should engine oil be changed?
sample_questions.question_km: តើត្រូវប្ដូរប្រេងម៉ាស៊ីនរៀងរាល់ពេលណា?
sample_questions.correct_answer_en: According to manufacturer's recommendations, typically every 5,000-10,000 km
sample_questions.correct_answer_km: តាមការណែនាំរបស់ក្រុមហ៊ុនផលិត ជាទូទៅរៀងរាល់ ៥,០០០-១០,០០០ គីឡូម៉ែត្រ

image_prompt.prompt: Cambodian auto mechanic draining dark used engine oil from car into collection pan, fresh golden new oil bottles visible on workbench, oil filter replacement shown, service sticker on windshield showing mileage intervals, professional automotive maintenance scene, realistic workshop photography, proper vehicle servicing demonstration
image_prompt.negative_prompt: cartoon, anime, dirty environment, improper disposal, blurry, low quality, amateur work

sample_questions.question_en: What does the battery warning light on the dashboard indicate?
sample_questions.question_km: តើភ្លើងព្រមានថ្មនៅលើផ្ទាំងគ្រប់គ្រងបង្ហាញពីអ្វី?
sample_questions.correct_answer_en: Charging system problem or low battery
sample_questions.correct_answer_km: បញ្ហាប្រព័ន្ធសាកថ្ម ឬថ្មទាប

image_prompt.prompt: Car dashboard close-up showing illuminated red battery warning light icon, other dashboard indicators visible, ignition key in position, modern vehicle instrument cluster, driver's perspective view, clear focus on battery symbol, realistic automotive interior photography, warning light diagnostic scenario
image_prompt.negative_prompt: cartoon, anime, all lights on, cracked dashboard, blurry, low quality, old vehicle

sample_questions.question_km: ហេតុអ្វីបានជាសម្ពាធកង់សំខាន់?
sample_questions.correct_answer_en: Proper pressure ensures safety, fuel efficiency, and tire longevity
sample_questions.correct_answer_km: សម្ពាធត្រឹមត្រូវធានាសុវត្ថិភាព ប្រសិទ្ធភាពប្រេងឥន្ធនៈ និងអាយុកាលកង់

image_prompt.prompt: Cambodian driver checking tire pressure using digital pressure gauge on car tire, tire pressure label visible on driver's door jamb, properly inflated tire with good tread visible, gas station air pump in background, vehicle maintenance best practice demonstration, realistic automotive care photography, daytime service station scene
image_prompt.negative_prompt: cartoon, anime, flat tire, no gauge, blurry, low quality, under-inflated tire

cambodia_context.lighting: daytime realistic lighting preferred for educational clarity

workflow: 1. Staff generates image using prompt from this JSON file
2. Staff reviews generated image for accuracy and cultural appropriateness
3. Staff uploads approved image to Cloudinary
4. Staff updates database with Cloudinary image URL
5. Staff records audio in both Khmer and English
6. Staff uploads audio files to Cloudinary
7. Staff changes question status from 'pending' to 'submitted'
8. Admin reviews complete question (text + image + audio)
9. Admin approves question status to 'approved' for public access
